concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-alternative-payment-methods-gift-cards-terminal-api]] — 2026-09-15 captured POS gift-card overview for Terminal API versus Stored Value API, card/PIN entry, mall-card MIDs, and dated provider-by-operation limits.
warnings: The provider matrix is historical: Givex-only deactivation and local-provider payment-only rows are in the source; do not generalize to current availability.
Store PIN caching is an optional Support-enabled choice with a 25-second to 30-minute timer; do not turn it into a default or universal card-PIN rule.
Stored Value API management substitution does not support payments or prove ecommerce payment-flow equivalence.
